items.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Monk, to really sit and talk about it.

ctx.x: Well, this has been a fascinating discussion. We’ve been talking with John Levy, who has seen the music business from a lot of different angles here, and it’s really been great talking to you.
Well it’s been a pleasure, truly, it’s really been a pleasure, Monk, to really sit and talk about it. I just wish I could have prepared a little better.
Well, you had some great thoughts.
